title: Linking Averaged and Unaveraged Three-Body Dynamics Near Smaller Primaries: Symmetric Periodic Orbits
summary: Within a three-body system comprised of two celestial bodies and a spacecraft, the dynamical environment near a smaller primary is significantly perturbed, motivating a balance between global insight and model fidelity. While averaged dynamics offer an integrable model to classify solution landscapes, they inherently lack the accuracy of the unaveraged dynamics, such as the Hill Restricted Three-Body Problem and Circular Restricted Three-Body Problem.
